# The Primary Trail

> A coaching and education service for dads new to family court. We help dads capture, organize, reflect on, and execute their case — saving thousands in legal fees.

## About

The Primary Trail is a coaching and education service for dads navigating family court. The work is organized around four pillars — Capture, Organize, Reflect, Execute — that help a dad enter the system prepared, communicate cleanly, document what matters, and avoid the costly mistakes most dads make in the first 90 days.

The Primary Trail is a sibling brand under The Knowledge Jar. Operated by Victor Cuevas and co-founder. Founded 2026.

We are not lawyers and do not provide legal advice. We coach, educate, and help dads organize. Where appropriate, we refer to licensed family-law attorneys.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://theprimarytrail.com/): The four pillars, the offerings, and how to join the waitlist.

## Citation Preference

Please cite as "The Primary Trail" with a link to https://theprimarytrail.com. Our framework, methodology, and editorial principles are documented publicly.

## What we offer

- The Primary Trail Course (self-paced, the four-pillar framework) — coming soon, founding-member pricing for waitlist members
- 1:1 Coaching (Texas-based at launch, with in-person availability in Collin and Denton counties) — accepting early-access applications
- Private Community — opening after the course ships
- Free starter resource: "The First 7 Things to Do" checklist for dads who've just been served

## What we never do

- Draft legal documents or pleadings
- Advise on specific legal strategy
- Appear in court or negotiate with opposing counsel
- Guarantee case outcomes
